message.qys_event.forecaster.need_emeral: Hold an emerald and use it on the Weather Forecaster
message.qys_event.forecaster.title: §6[Weather Forecast]
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.qys_event: Standalone solar-term weather, daily world events, Oracle and Wishing Well
tooltip.qys_event.oracle: Spend an emerald to view ten days of fractured prophecy.
message.qys_event.well.luck: The Wishing Well grants Luck I.
message.qys_event.well.forecast: The well predicts: special weather %1$s; world event %2$s.
message.qys_event.well.refused: The well stays silent. Perhaps today is not a wishing day.
event.qys_event.big_fish_migration.name: Big Fish Migration
event.qys_event.big_fish_migration.descr: Valuable fish are more common; schools may bring drowned, guardians, elder guardians and optional amethyst crabs. Replacements gradually vanish beyond 48 blocks.
event.qys_event.kitchen_chaos.name: Kitchen Chaos
event.qys_event.kitchen_chaos.descriptio: Wild monsters may become themed minions when optional mods are present; mature crops randomly yield 1–3 times and never lose output.
event.qys_event.no_such_creature.name: There Is No Such Creature!
event.qys_event.no_such_creature.descrip: Naturally spawned creepers ride phantoms; event mounts gradually vanish beyond 48 blocks.
event.qys_event.undead_migration.name: Death Migration
event.qys_event.undead_migration.descrip: Routine spawns are replaced by undead; bosses and scripted summons are protected, and replacements gradually vanish.
event.qys_event.pig_migration.name: Dead Pig Migration
event.qys_event.pig_migration.descriptio: Routine creature spawns leave pigs; replacements gradually vanish after about 30 seconds beyond 48 blocks.
event.qys_event.heavy_snow.name: Heavy Snow
event.qys_event.heavy_snow.description: Brown foul rain lasts all day; exposed players suffer Nausea and Poop?! Wild hostiles may become Sir Apple and Compost Superman minions—flies, maggots and dung creatures—with a tiny chance for a Giant Grub.
event.qys_event.kobe_memorial.name: Kobe Memorial Day
event.qys_event.kobe_memorial.descriptio: Every player receives one bottle of iced tea today, once per player.
event.qys_event.harvest_moon.name: Harvest Moon
event.qys_event.harvest_moon.description: Crops grow faster and mature crop drops are doubled.
event.qys_event.slime_rain.name: Slime Rain
event.qys_event.slime_rain.description: One quarter of routine hostiles become slimes, or magma cubes in the Nether.
event.qys_event.blood_moon.name: Crimson Moon-Tide
event.qys_event.blood_moon.description: Routine hostile spawns gain Strength, Speed and glowing; player kills have a 30% chance to drop redstone.
event.qys_event.gold_rush.name: Gilded Veins
event.qys_event.gold_rush.description: Only blocks in the Forge ores tag can produce bonus gold nuggets or raw gold.
event.qys_event.rabbit_tide.name: Runaway Rabbit Tide
event.qys_event.rabbit_tide.description: 65% of routine animal spawns become rabbits; replacements gradually vanish.
event.qys_event.witch_convention.name: Witches’ Tea Convention
event.qys_event.witch_convention.descrip: 40% of routine hostile spawns become witches; replacements gradually vanish.
event.qys_event.gravity_glitch.name: Gravity Malfunction
event.qys_event.gravity_glitch.descripti: Most routine creatures briefly float; players periodically gain Jump Boost II and Slow Falling.
event.qys_event.mushroom_bloom.name: Mushroom Overgrowth
event.qys_event.mushroom_bloom.descripti: 35% of routine animals become mooshrooms; leaves and flowers may shake loose mushrooms.
event.qys_event.ender_eclipse.name: Ender Eclipse
event.qys_event.ender_eclipse.descriptio: 28% of routine hostiles become endermen; violet spatial noise appears at night.
event.qys_event.firefly_night.name: Firefly Night
event.qys_event.firefly_night.descriptio: Lights drift after dusk; player kills have a 24% chance to drop glowstone dust.
event.qys_event.lucky_day.name: Lucky Day
event.qys_event.lucky_day.description: Players retain Luck I; hostile kills may drop emeralds or iron nuggets.
event.qys_event.starfall.name: Starfall Night
event.qys_event.starfall.description: Stardust crosses the night, some creatures glow, and hostile kills may drop amethyst or emeralds.
message.qys_event.kobe_gift: Kobe Memorial Day: you received a bottle of iced tea.
message.qys_event.event_test.clear_hover: Clear today’s forced event. Normal random rolls resume next game day.
message.qys_event.event_test.cleared: [Event Test] Today’s event was cleared. Normal random rolls resume next game day.
message.qys_event.event_test.unknown: Unknown world event: %s. Use /ftevent list to see every ID.
message.qys_event.oracle.glitch.5: D+%s: triggered: an event that does not exist
message.qys_event.oracle.glitch.7: D+%s: the weather says yes; the cat says no.
message.qys_event.daily_event.not_trigge: Today’s world event did not trigger
